name: io.github.agentwares/okgate
description: Nothing irreversible without an OK: MCP policy proxy with spend caps, approvals, kill switch.
title: okgate

environmentVariables.name: OKGATE_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to okgate.yaml (default ./okgate.yaml, else ./agentguard.yaml; AGENTGUARD_CONFIG also works). With neither file, okgate serves only its own read-only tools: okgate_get_status, okgate_get_report, okgate_verify_audit_log

environmentVariables.name: OKGATE_KILL
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to halt every tool call (kill switch); AGENTGUARD_KILL=1 does the same
